risk_mitigations.mitigation: Scout weekly from emergence; act at 10-20% damaged plants with PCPB-registered products at early instar; consider push-pull.
Early planting, destroy crop residues, apply registered granules into the funnel when damage appears.
Use pheromone traps and insect netting; rotate registered active ingredients; remove infested leaves.
Plant early-maturing/drought-tolerant varieties, mulch, and prepare drip or furrow irrigation and on-farm water pans before onset.

risk_mitigations.mitigation: Wait for 20-25 mm cumulative rain before dry-planting; stagger planting; keep seed in reserve for gap-filling.
Irrigate in early morning, use shade nets on nurseries, and time flowering away from the hottest weeks.
Stagger planting in 2-3 blocks two weeks apart and pre-sell part of the crop to an offtaker.

compliance_flags: [KFS] Mau Forest Complex: No cultivation inside gazetted forest boundaries.
[NEMA] Wetlands and river banks: EMCA (Wetlands, River Banks, Lake Shores and Sea Shore Management) Regulations, 2009: conversion or drainage of wetlands needs NEMA approval and may need an EIA.
[WRA] Riparian reserve: No cultivation or structures on riparian land (6 m minimum, up to 30 m from the highest-ever water mark depending on watercourse width); abstraction needs a WRA permit.
